description: Ask Verse's "joke" skill (Words and the world), one of the proven skills with the most evidence that Verse offers over MCP (read-only): rated proven on a-to-mind.com from evidence (real asks in Verse's benchmark, its tests), never from how it describes itself. Asks like "tell me a joke", "make me laugh", "tell me a dad joke". Over MCP it is answered the way ask_void is: Verse's answer engine (a model, citing Wikipedia when it matches; up to 12 a minute per caller). The skill itself works it out on its own card at the "open" link in the result.

ask.description: The ask in plain words (3 to 600 characters), e.g. "tell me a joke".

response_type.description: What to get back: 'text' (default) or 'raw_data' (the structured result as JSON). 'image' is not offered yet.
